description: The line plot illustrates the relationship between the number of child nodes (tree width) and the accuracy of the GPT-4o model. The x-axis is labeled "Number of Child Nodes (Tree Width)" and is a linear scale ranging from 1 to 5. The y-axis is labeled "Accuracy@1 (%)" and is a linear scale ranging from 20 to 35. The plot features two lines: one representing the GPT-4o model, which is marked with a blue line and a star marker, and the other representing the Claude model, which is marked with a blue line and a circle marker. The GPT-4o line starts at an accuracy of 24.4% with 1 child node, increases to 26.7% with 2 child nodes, peaks at 34.4% with 3 child nodes, then decreases to 31.1% with 5 child nodes. The Claude line starts at an accuracy of 24.4% with 1 child node, increases to 27.8% with 2 child nodes, peaks at 28.9% with 3 child nodes, and then decreases to 20.0% with 5 child nodes.
